verdict.rationale: Skyvern documents agents that run unattended in a cloud browser: Copilot-built agents can be scheduled, runs are started via the REST API, and a webhook POST fires when a run finishes. Automatic CAPTCHA solving and stored credentials with 2FA filling let runs proceed without a human, and cached code makes repeat runs deterministic. Missing for 10: detailed scheduling/trigger documentation (only one mention of 'schedule'), independent hands-on corroboration of reliable unattended background runs.
